Render an interactive synteny plot

Source: R/girafe.R
syn_girafe.Rd

Wraps a plot built with interactive = TRUE (see plot_synteny() / plot_microsynteny()) into a ggiraph widget with hover highlighting and tooltips, for HTML output (R Markdown, Quarto, Shiny, pkgdown).

Usage

syn_girafe(
  p,
  width_svg = 10,
  height_svg = 6,
  hover_css = "fill-opacity:0.9;stroke:#333333;stroke-width:1.2px;",
  opts = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

p

A ggplot built with interactive = TRUE.

width_svg, height_svg

Width and height of the underlying SVG, in inches. Synteny plots are usually wide: the defaults are 10 x 6.

hover_css

CSS applied to the hovered element.

opts

A list of additional ggiraph::opts_*() options.

...

Passed on to ggiraph::girafe().

Value

A girafe htmlwidget.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
syn <- example_synteny_data()
p <- plot_synteny(syn, c("Arabidopsis", "Grape", "Rice"),
                  palette = "casa_natal", interactive = TRUE)
syn_girafe(p)
} # }
